title: IT Infra & ERP Expert
description:
We are looking for a dynamic and analytical professional with Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Electronics, or related discipline. At least 10 years of experience in ERP/SAP systems, asset databases, digital records management, IT infrastructure, automation systems, or data analytics. The ideal candidate should have strong skills in project management, research, data analysis, stakeholder engagement, and client coordination, with experience in preparing reports, presentations, and supporting planning and consulting assignments.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
• Manage and review ERP/SAP systems and digital asset databases.
  
• Maintain and validate digital records, asset registers, and project documentation.
  
• Assess IT infrastructure and automation systems supporting asset management.
  
• Conduct data analytics, data validation, and reconciliation of asset records.
  
• Identify gaps in digital records and recommend improvements in data management systems.
  
• Support asset verification through digital tools and technology-enabled processes.
  
• Prepare analytical reports and dashboards to support project assessment and decision-making.
  
• Ensure data accuracy, integrity, security, and proper documentation of digital records
  
Desired Candidate Profile
  
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related discipline.
  
• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in ERP/SAP systems, IT infrastructure, or digital asset management.
  
• Expertise in asset databases, digital records management, and data management systems.
  
• Experience in automation systems, data analytics, and technology-driven process improvement.
  
• Strong analytical and technical skills to support asset verification, data validation, and digital reporting.

title: Executive - IT
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide first-level support for business applications, including ERP modules; log, track and resolve user tickets within agreed timelines and escalate complex issues to the respective manager.
* Understand and monitor how data and transactions flow across departments through the system.
* Support the maintenance, testing and improvement of the company’s in-house software.
* Identify and correct data errors with the concerned department; maintain master data discipline as per the data-entry rules set by the IT Head.
* Prepare and share routine MIS and system reports for users and management.
* Able to act as a functional coordinator, i.e. the link between users and developers: gathering and documenting user requirements, explaining them to developers, and testing and validating the software (UAT) before release.
* Coordinate with department heads on software requirements and process gaps, and with external vendors and service providers when needed.
* Click photographs of products along with their unique product code and upload them to the designated system or platform.

**Qualifications And Technical Skills**

* Diploma in Software / Computer Science/ B.Sc. IT / BCA in IT.
* Fresher or 0-2 years of relevant experience.
* Working knowledge of any business software or ERP; exposure to SAP (Supply Chain / Sales modules) preferred.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office; basic knowledge of databases (SQL) is an advantage.
* Must have Clear communication, Willingness to learn, Attention to detail, Logical Thinking, Problem solving ability & Ability to prioritize tasks.
